recall_tail_principle: Tier B is not equivalent to irrelevant. B1 and B2 preserve the acquisition path for unresolved candidates that may be scientifically valuable.

retrospective_affected_definitions.POLICY_A_MINIMAL: An acquired candidate is affected only when it was originally Tier A and loses shadow Tier-A eligibility.
retrospective_affected_definitions.POLICY_B_CONSERVATIVE_PRIORITY: An acquired candidate is affected when it was originally Tier A and loses shadow Tier-A eligibility, or when its conservative priority class is B2, B3, or INCOMPATIBLE_DIAGNOSTIC rather than Tier-A-eligible or B1.
retrospective_affected_definitions.POLICY_C_STRICT_FULLTEXT_ELIGIBILITY: An acquired candidate is affected when it was originally Tier A and loses shadow Tier-A eligibility, or when Policy C makes it fulltext-ineligible.
